steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Switch the default event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet and attachment flow are available.
Add the requested product and quantity.
Complete the remaining required sheet fields, including delivery location where needed.
Upload the closest supported PDF fixture to represent the first attachment.
Upload a second supported fixture to represent the second attachment.
Add one QA vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Commit the required 30-minute schedule.
Publish the configured RFQ event.
Confirm that publishing reached a real project page.
Open the project details area where quotation attachments should be listed.
Check that the project details show two quotation-template attachments.
Check that two attachment download links are present for the buyer.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the event overview where vendor-visible attachments should be available.
Check that the vendor portal exposes two download controls.
